notes: First round of a UX audit: cross-tab system focus and navigation clarity. (1) New focusOnSystem() -- picking a specific system in any one of Technical Audit, Support & Ops, Value & ROI, or Action Planner's selectors now carries that same system to the other three, instead of each tab tracking its own selection independently and forcing you to re-pick the same system up to 4 times when moving between tabs. Selecting 'All Systems' or a cluster/group/watchlist scope stays tab-local on purpose. (2) Added descriptive tooltips to all 5 main sidebar nav items (previously only Overview/Action Planner/Settings had them) so it's clear what's actually inside 'Value & ROI' or 'Support & Ops' without having to click in and look. (3) Relabeled the sidebar 'Reset' button to 'Clear Filters' to distinguish it from the logo/Overview click, which resets filters AND navigates to Overview -- two visually similar controls previously did overlapping-but-different things.
